name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-AMR
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for AGV/AMR fleets: a real, hand-checkable 2D rigid-body transform (FrameTransform) from the factory's shared coordinate frame into a specific AMR's local frame, plus a minimal VDA-5050-inspired order-action vocabulary (MOVE_TO_*/PICK_LOAD/DROP_LOAD/CANCEL_ORDER) gated through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety contract. Never plans a path or avoids an obstacle itself - that authority stays with the AMR's own onboard navigation or its fleet manager. No real fleet-manager REST/WebSocket adapter or physical AMR validated yet.
